aiResearchSummary.text: CB Therapeutics is engaged in biosynthetic production of cannabinoids from sugar, as reflected in research on engineered olivetolic acid cyclase enzymes for cannabinoid biosynthesis, methods for modifying cannabinoids using enzymes, prenyltransferase enzymes optimized for microbial or plant production, and malonate transporters that enhance precursor molecule output for cannabinoid synthesis. These activities encompass enzyme engineering, metabolic pathway optimization, and cannabinoid modification.
